name: PraisonAI
description: Agent framework and CLI for running one agent or a whole team that researches, plans and executes tasks.
whatItDoes: Users launch autonomous agents, from a single assistant up to an organisation of agents, that carry out research, planning and task execution across applications with little boilerplate.
howItWorks: Installed through a shell installer or pip, it provides a command line documented in the CLI reference alongside a Python package for defining agents.
